name: EPIC 203791956

text.card: A red giant 6,002 parsecs away, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.85 solar masses and 19.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,310 K at its surface.
